ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) background with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible fluke plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black base surface; high-contrast white linear and circular pixel clusters scattered bilaterally; prominent high-intensity irregular blobs localized at the distal fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated acute angle (~50 degrees) between the upper lobe boundaries; lower vertex is submerged/occluded by water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire visible trailing boundary; multiple distinct pixel-depth indentations (nicks) located at various intervals on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular high-intensity pixel clusters (2-10 pixel radii) distributed across both lobes, with highest density in the central and inner-left regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Abundant thin, high-contrast white linear pixel paths ranging from 5 to 80 pixels in length, primarily oriented along a vertical-to-diagonal axis, most concentrated on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant high-intensity white textured clusters consistent with calcified deposits localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
